description: Measurement coverage by world region (continent by default, or UN sub-region with level=subregion): countries measured and measurement counts. Block fractions and confirmed national block counts are under review, because they counted CensoredPlanet rows and IODA outages as blocks or came from the national blocklist layer, which let false positives through in open countries and is being rebuilt with a stricter rule; they return null with a review object and its data date.
name: get_censorship_by_region
